candidate_verdict.note: a REJECT here is a measurement outcome, not a discarded file: the code, its numbers and the reason stay in OPTIMIZATION_LEDGER.md
candidate_verdict.rule: ACCEPT iff deciding-cell gain > 0 with 95 % CI excluding 0, and no cell regressing by more than 2 x the A/A median band

environment.governor: NOT AVAILABLE (not exposed in this container)
environment.host_note: containerised host; perf_event_open is blocked by seccomp and valgrind is not installed, so hardware counters and callgrind-style attribution are recorded as NOT AVAILABLE rather than substituted
environment.lto: OFF for every engine (LTO across a dlopen boundary would be an asymmetry)
environment.max_freq_khz: NOT AVAILABLE (not exposed in this container)
environment.min_freq_khz: NOT AVAILABLE (not exposed in this container)
environment.nohz_: clocksource=kvm-clock i8042.noaux i8042.nokbd init=/sbin/init ip=169.254.0.21::169.254.0.22:255.255.255.252:instance:eth0:off:tap0 ipv6.autoconf=1 ipv6.disable=0 loglevel=1 panic=1 pci=off quiet random.trust_cpu=on reboot=k rootflags=discard pci=off virtio_mmio.device=4K@0xc0001000:6 root=/dev/vda rw virtio_mmio.device=4K@0xc0002000:7 virtio_mmio.device=4K@0xc0003000:8 virtio_mmio.device=4K@0xc0004000:9
environment.note_flags: these are what build.sh uses for EVERY engine TU; the product's CMake Release configuration is -O3 -DNDEBUG, and the manifest is generated from the build script rather than typed, so the two cannot drift apart silently
environment.pgo: NOT USED (a PGO build trained on the benchmark corpus would be benchmark overfitting by construction)
environment.warn_flags_bench: -w (bench builds are warning-silent by design; the engine itself is compiled with the repo's own CMake warning set for product builds)

toolchain.lto: OFF for every engine (LTO across a dlopen boundary would be an asymmetry)
toolchain.pgo: NOT USED (a PGO build trained on the benchmark corpus would be benchmark overfitting by construction)
toolchain.warn_flags_bench: -w (bench builds are warning-silent by design; the engine itself is compiled with the repo's own CMake warning set for product builds)

memory_note: alloc_soak counts allocations made by the harness driver plus the engine over a soak of soak_keys keys; the engine itself is expected to contribute a constant, not a per-key cost

meta.sessions_note: sessions counted from the timed rows' own _file field; rounds/keys/words/seed come from that pass's meta row

profile.note: delivered = samples / measured window; the gap to the requested rate is the kernel tick (CONFIG_HZ) limiting ITIMER_PROF, not the harness

verdict.label: TIER MIXED — faster on some cells, slower on others (no win wording allowed)
